identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start at (0,0). Open: right, left. Both lead to down turns. Choosing right first.
At (1,0). Up and right are blocked. Down leads to (1,-1) which turns right. Left leads back to start. Moving down.
At (1,-1). Came from up (1,0). Open: up, right. Moving right to explore corridor towards (2,-1) and (3,-1).
At (2,-1). In horizontal corridor between (1,-1) and (3,-1). Moving right towards (3,-1) which has an up turn.
At (3,-1). Open directions: up, left. Up corridor extends 3 steps to (3,2) which turns left. Left goes back to (2,-1). Moving up.
At (3,0). Vertical corridor continuing up. Sightline shows cell at (3,2) turns left. Moving up.
At (3,1). Vertical corridor continuing up to (3,2), which opens left. Moving up.
At (3,2). Reached corner. Open: down, left. Left leads to (2,2) with open directions up and right. Moving left.
At (2,2). Came from right (3,2). Open: up, right. Up leads to (2,3) which opens right and down. Moving up to explore forward.
At (2,3). Open directions: right, down. Down goes back to (2,2). Right goes down a horizontal corridor of length 3 ending at (5,3) with an up turn. Moving right.
At (3,3). Horizontal corridor towards (5,3). (4,3) is straight, (5,3) turns up. Moving right.
At (4,3). Horizontal corridor. Ahead at distance 1 to the right is (5,3) which opens up and left. Moving right to reach (5,3).
At (5,3). Open: up, left. Up sightline distance 2: (5,4) opens up,down,left; (5,5) opens down,left. Moving up.
At (5,4). T-junction: open up, down, left. Up leads to (5,5) which turns left. Left leads to a corridor (4,4)-(2,4) turning up. Let's explore up first to check (5,5).

At (5,5). Dead-end / corner path: open down and left. Left sightline: (4,5) opens [right, left], (3,5) opens [right] (dead end). So left path terminates at (3,5)! Let's head back down to (5,4) and explore left corridor there.
Back at (5,4) junction. Up goes to dead end at (3,5). Left goes down corridor: (4,4) [R,L], (3,4) [R,L], (2,4) [U,R]. Taking left to explore.
At (4,4). Corridor heading left towards (2,4) which turns up. Open: right, left. Continuing left.
At (3,4). Corridor continuing left to (2,4) which opens up and right. Moving left to reach (2,4).
At (2,4). Open: up, right. Up leads to (2,5) which opens down, left. Moving up to explore.
At (2,5). Open: down, left. Left sightline shows (1,5) which opens [right, down]. Down goes back to (2,4). Moving left to (1,5).
At (1,5). Open directions: right, down. Down sightline shows distance 2: (1,4) [up, down], (1,3) [up, left]. Moving down.
At (1,4). Vertical corridor. Down leads to (1,3) which opens up and left. Moving down.
At (1,3). Open: up, left. Left sightline shows (0,3) which opens [up, right]. Up leads back to (1,4). Moving left to (0,3).
At (0,3). Open: up, right. Up sightline: (0,4) [up, down], (0,5) [down, left]. Right leads back to (1,3). Moving up to explore (0,4).
At (0,4). Open: up, down. Up sightline distance 1 shows (0,5) opens [down, left]. Down leads back to (0,3). Moving up towards (0,5).

At (0,5). Open: down, left. Left sightline: (-1,5) [R,L], (-2,5) [R,L], (-3,5) [R] (dead end). Wait, (-3,5) opens only [R]! But down leads back to (0,4). Let's check left anyway or see if there's any opening. Actually (-3,5) is dead end. But left is the only forward path.
